Subject: Post-discovery: 30-min product tour — two slot choices & stakeholder asks

Hi Jane & Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and helpful context on Avery Systems' ingestion pipeline and the latency/cost constraints for batch inference. Quick recap from our side: you want a follow-up 30-minute product tour that focuses on (1) how Redwood handles high-throughput streaming with prefix caching, (2) our quantization and cost controls, and (3) deployment options (hosted vs dedicated) with the basic security considerations.

To keep this narrow and useful for your team, can you confirm which two stakeholders will join? From the discovery it sounded like a product manager + an infra lead would be ideal. If you need to loop in a procurement or security contact we can do that in a later session.

Proposed 30-minute windows (all times PT):
- Option A: Wednesday, Aug 6 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Thursday, Aug 7 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If neither works, tell me two times that do and we’ll match. I’ve attached a short agenda (one pager) so the stakeholders know what to expect.

Prep asks:
- Please share the names/emails of the two attendees you want on the call
- If there are any network/firewall constraints or a short SSO/KMS question, flag it so our SE can prepare

I’m looping in Monica (CS & onboarding) and Hannah (sales engineer) so they can attend the tour — Hannah will cover integration patterns and performance expectations.

Best,
Marcus Lin
